article.title: José Carlos Mariátegui and Local Traditions of Struggle
article.author: Jamil Jonna
article.content: The relationship between Marxism and other revolutionary traditions is a key question for our time. If we approach the issue incorrectly, we risk Eurocentrism and underrecognizing Marxism’s role in the Global South contexts where it is most vital and active. This article examines and extends José Carlos Mariátegui’s dialectical approach to the issue, which demonstrates how Marxism is not diluted but strengthened through engagement with the thought and practice of existing struggles, while those struggles can, in turn, gain greater depth and groundedness through the same relationship. The post José Carlos Mariátegui and Local Traditions of Struggle appeared first on Monthly Review .
